summary.text: Kris Fair is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 3, in Frederick County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The executive director of The Frederick Center, he has served in the House since January 2023 and chairs the Election Law Subcommittee of the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee.

paragraphs.text: Fair was born in Montgomery County and graduated from Linganore High School in 2002.
He earned an A.A. in general studies from Frederick Community College in 2008 and a B.A. in political science and history from Hood College in 2013.

He was campaign manager for the Frederick County Democratic Party in 2014, executive director of the Frederick Festival of the Arts from 2013 to 2016, legislative director for Delegate Karen Lewis Young from 2021 to 2022, and has been executive director of The Frederick Center since 2021.
Fair was vice chair of the Frederick County Democratic State Central Committee in 2013-2014 and chaired the board of The Frederick Center from 2015 to 2021.
He was elected to the House of Delegates in 2022, served on the Ways and Means Committee from 2023 to 2025, and in 2026 sits on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee.
He has chaired the Maryland Legislative LGBTQ+ Caucus since 2023.
